description: This map displays a detailed land cover classification for a generic European landscape, featuring various polygonal areas and linear features. The primary land cover areas are shown as light green polygons, each labelled with a four-digit numeric code. These codes include: 1110, 1120, 1210, 1220, 1400, 2110, 4100, 4212, and 8110. A network of linear features, appearing to be roads or associated transport infrastructure, is highlighted in light purple and consistently labelled with the numeric code 3500. Delineating the boundaries of these classified areas are thin grey lines. In the bottom right corner, a partially obscured Geographic Information System (GIS) "Identify" pop-up window is visible, indicating an "Identified 1 feature" from the "<Top-most layer>" with a "Location" coordinate of "4.201.818,524 2.989.572,209 Meters". The map illustrates the intricate spatial distribution of different land cover/land use types, with the numeric codes representing specific classification categories, although a full legend for these codes is not provided in the image. No scale bar, compass, or reference year is present.
